notes.title: Beat Banger Mod Download Fix Patch
notes.notes:
This is, by no means, a regular update, but since the bbooru.fun domain expired after we acquired their site; downloading mods from the old fetch URL no longer works. 

[h3]THE NEW MODS MENU IS CURRENTLY VERY BUGGY[/h3]

We believe having a slightly buggy menu is better than having downloads that do not work at all, so for now, I'm pushing this patch. However, we'll quickly fix all of the small annoying bugs in the next regular update and make it a lot more intuitive to use. I'll also be updating tags and aliases to make it easier to find the mods you're looking for and a way to find mods by creators and by the title of the mod.

Included with the improved mod browser, we'll also be getting ready to implement the ability for mod creators to add cutscenes. This update will allow for full storytelling experiences and custom campaigns to be played and shared amongst players.

TLDR[b] Beat Banger was using the name of the current mod pack and the current level[/b] to try and locate the saved data; this meant that if you changed the name of your mod pack or your level, then it could not properly access the save data in your app data folder.

[b]We finally got Lovense support integrated into Beat Banger.[/b] To access it, go into the options and click on [b]"Lovense Mode"[/b] (Under the Game Section). There will be instructions for connecting your Lovense Devices in the pop-up menu. You'll need to download the Lovense Connect app and ensure your phone is connected to your computer's wifi network. 

Note: The Lovense API sends POST requests over your local network to communicate with your devices. You may experience a slight delay depending on your internet speed. To fix this, we'll also be working on integrating the [b]Buttplug.io[/b] web socket protocol for more accurate and high-speed vibration communication in the future.
